$comment: BridgeEscrow post-deploy config for Gnosis (100). See 1.json for field semantics. The bridge uses the LOGICAL symbol `USDC` (the source-chain symbol carried unchanged in the invoice) mapped here to the bridged USDC.e token 0x2a22f9c3 (its on-chain symbol() is 'USDC.e') — the token Stargate delivers on Gnosis. USD<->Gnosis is Stargate-ONLY: Stargate delivers exactly this token, whereas the Gnosis omnibridge delivers the LEGACY 'USD//C on xDai' token (0xDDAfbb50) and CCIP has no Gnosis token pool. So the omnibridge (Gnosis adapter) carries WETH only, and CCIP is disabled on Gnosis. WETH (0x6A02…) is a single token across every bridge, so it is unambiguous both ways.
